Free Dental Consultations Get in touch with us today ( 602) 279-7312 Make an Appointment Dental Implants Implants offer a stable as well as a secure fit for the replacement of a single tooth. The artificial tooth is being supported by the implant making the restoration look almost like a natural tooth. LEARN MORE Equipment, Process & Technology A smile is a curve that sets everything straight! Intraoral Camera An Intraoral camera can significantly increase precision in diagnosis. This highly advanced piece of equipment allows you to see what we see. Biometric Diagnosis Used in conjunction with T-Scan and X-Ray, we are able to analyze a variety of oral-related problems and determine the best method of treatment. Find Out More Bite Guard This device is the only FDA approved, non-medication migraine prevention system proven in clinical studies to significantly reduce migraine discomfort. Patient Testimonials See What Our Patients Are Saying “Excellent dental services provided to me by you and your staff. The final results of my treatment were truly outstanding and exceeded my expectations. Without hesitation, I recommend you to anyone seeking high-quality dental care.” GERRY MARTING “I have been very happy with my new ”smile.” My friends noticed even the temporaries and thought they were great. The look and color improvement were apparent even then. The finished product has been nothing but satisfactory.” EILEEN HAGA “I was so impressed with the new smile you created for Eileen that, even though I was a 66-year-old professional, I wanted to improve my smile, too. I have been extremely satisfied with the results and have received many compliments.” DAVID HAGA “Thank you so much for the difference you and your team have made to me. My teeth look exactly what I wanted and more. You did the most wonderful thing that anyone could have done for me. You gave me back my smile!” ANA CHADWICK The Biting Edge is Arizona's leading Cosmetic & Family Dental Practice Aesthetic, Contemporary, Restorative Orthodontics & Cosmetic Rehabilitation The team at The Biting Edge is dedicated to ensuring oral health for the entire family. Our friendly team helps everyone in the family feel at ease. We are comfortable and trained to treat patients of all ages, from the very young all the way through life.
